items.title: SEEK FULFILLMENT
items.text: Seek your fulfillment in life through activities that ennoble you spiritually. These are the activities that make you an “ish” (the highest form of human being) rather than those that degrade you, like building wealth for its own sake or achieving power over others.
“Fortunate is the man.” “He is like a tree that has been planted beside streams of water.” Ask Hashem for sustenance, health and happiness
items.title: BASIC NEEDS
AVOID RISK OF SIN
items.quote: who has not spent time on the path of sinful people.
items.text: Avoid situations in which you are vulnerable to sinful behavior, even if it is unintentional or inadvertent.

items.title: AVOID IDLENESS
items.quote: who has not sat in the gatherings of scoffers.
items.text: Don’t expend your valuable time in idle conversation, mockery, and sarcasm.

items.title: LEARN TORAH
items.quote: Rather his only desire is for Hashem’s Torah.
items.text: Devote yourself to the wisdom of Torah, not only to learn it but to make the Torah part of you.

items.title: CHILDREN
items.quote: which yields its fruit in due season.
items.text: Ask Hashem for the blessing of good and healthy children to follow in your footsteps.

items.title: SUCCESS
items.quote: everything that he does is successful.
items.text: Ask Hashem for success in your endeavors and initiatives.

items.title: VERDICT IN JUDGMENT
items.quote: for Hashem knows the way of the tzaddikim.
items.text: Ask Hashem to be counted among the tzaddikim and not among the resha’im so that your destiny will be that of the tzaddikim.

items.title: OPEN UP
items.quote: for Hashem knows the way of the tzaddikim.
items.text: Open yourself up to Hashem. Let Him in to your heart, so that He can actively know you.
